note: Runtime UI rows whose translation is wrong in sense. The guides use a correct term; these rows need a runtime-catalog fix.

defects.Anndata out: 'Anndata fora' means 'Anndata outside'; the setting is the AnnData output file ('Saída do AnnData')
defects.Model zoo…: 'Modelo de jardim zoológico...' means 'model of a zoological garden'; the screen is 'Biblioteca de modelos'
defects.Promote calls to annotation: 'Promova chamadas para anotação' reads 'promote (phone) calls for annotation'; the action turns calls into annotations
defects.Undo promotion: 'Desfazer promoção' reads as undoing a sales/job promotion
defects.Taper onto the gradient: 'Aperte o degradê' means 'squeeze the colour gradient'
defects.Train: 'Comboio' is a railway train (European Portuguese); the Workbench tab means 'Treinar'
defects.Walk: 'Andar' means walking on foot; the switch selects the local step-by-step search ('Busca passo a passo')
defects.Hit List: 'Lista de acertos' means a list of correct answers; screen hits are candidates ('Lista de candidatos')
defects.Setting animations: 'Configurando animações' reads 'configuring animations'; the preference means animations for settings ('Animações das configurações')
